overview.Module Title: Introduction to Chinese Language and Culture 1

sections.Aims and Fit of Module: 教学目标： 《中国文化概论（上）》是针对一年级台港地区新生开设的一门中国文化类基础课。本课程旨在通过对中国文化的概略性学习、体会。增强对中国传统文化的认知，提升学生文化素养。
sections.Learning outcomes: After the whole session was completed, all students will be able to grasp the basic development and outstanding features of traditional Chinese culture.
sections.Method of teaching and learning: 教学手段： 理论讲授与实地考察实践相结合。
